"She Who Is within the Hovering Shelter of Her Lord, Respected One, veiled one whose form is hidden, who seizes breasts and opens of herself."

spell145_pylon20_keeper.name: Keeper of the twentieth pylon

descriptions.default: A god whose human face is shown from the front looks over the twentieth pylon as its keeper. He is the veiler of the Weary One.

spell145_pylon20_keeper.reference: Allen 1974 (21st-dynasty text: the pylon "is under the inspection of the veiler of the Weary One"); Davis 1894 for the head

descriptions.default: The deceased raises his hands before the twentieth pylon. He knows its name and the name of its keeper, and is told: "Go through, thou art pure."
"She Who Sharpens Flint To Speak for Her, Pale of Face, who cannot be overturned, whose flame descends."

spell145_pylon21_keeper.name: Keeper of the twenty-first pylon

descriptions.default: Bes, the lion-maned dwarf god with a plumed crown, looks over the twenty-first pylon as its keeper. "Giraffe" is his name. Seven gods keep the pylon with him.

spell145_pylon21_keeper.reference: Allen 1974 (21st-dynasty text); Davis 1894 for the head (Davis names "the Devouring One" as the avenger of the god he keeps)

descriptions.default: The deceased raises his hands before the twenty-first pylon. He knows its name and the name of its keeper, and is told: "Go through, thou art pure."
"Lady of Trembling, lofty of battlements, supreme one, lady of breaking and entering, uttering proclamations, warding off storms, rescuing the plundered whether present or far away."
"Lady of the Sky, mistress of the Two Lands, wailer, lady of all mankind, reckoning everyone."
"Lady of the Altar, great of offerings, refreshing every God in her on the day of sailing upstream to Abydos."
"Mighty of Knives, mistress of the Two Lands, punishing the enemies of the weary-hearted one, fulfilling the wishes of him who is void of evil."
"Fire, lady of magic, joyous one to whom prayer is made without a bald-head coming near her."

"Lady of Darkness, loud-roaring, whose length and breadth are unknown, whose character has not been recognized from her beginning, on whom are snakes innumerable, she who was born before the weary-hearted one."
"Iggyt Veiling the Weary One, mourner who desires to conceal the body."
"Kindler of Flames, Quencher of Embers, skilled in use of fire, quick of hand, slaying without compunction, whom none want to pass through for fear of her pain."

"Foremost One, tranquil Possessor of Power, Offspring of her lord, 350 hundred-cubits in circumference, sown with green stone of Upper Egypt, who raises up the Enterer and veils the weary one, who makes gifts to her Lord every day."
"Loud-voiced, awaker of outcries, laugher, terrible in awesomeness, she who repels not him that is within her."
"She Who Cuts Repeatedly, who burns rebels, terror of every portal, to whom jubilation is made each day at twilight."
"She Whom Her Two Lands Invoke, who annihilates them that come at dawn, bright one, lady of the blessed, hearkening to her Lord every day."
"She over Whom Isis Has Extended Her Arms, whom the inundation instructs in his secrets."
"Lady of Wrath, dancing on red blood, for whom the Haker-feast is celebrated on the day of hearing wrongs."

"Hostile Soul, red of eyelashes, cross-eyed one who goes forth by night, who seizes the rebel by his coil, who extends her arms to the weary-hearted one at his appointed instant, who comes back if she goes away."
